svg.text: CHG adapter carrier (CR) and EVM interface board (EIB): schematic, round 4 r8
Net-label schematic. Values from calc/r3_calc.py; pin numbers in design section B.8. Every net name matches section B
I_OL 2.05-2.41 A; fast-trip 2x; UVLO 9.9 V; OVP 23.1 V (22.6-23.6); ramp 2.19 V/ms; no clamp diode on IMON
REF -R141 61.9k- IN+ -R142 1.00k SOT- KELVIN (T9); R143 100R KELVIN-GND
STAT pad 3: R107 10k to 3V3 -> J101.4. SDA/SCL pads 8/7 -> W7; R145/R146 DNP (pull-ups MB 2.7k, PM9).
4 Keep-alive option (DO NOT POPULATE unless T-B-09 fails)
VCHG held 3.63-4.46 V while REGEN is closed; 0.7-1.4 mA in Run, 0.5-2.3 uA parked; QOD open
2b r6: EN-net comparators and pack-OV permit input
U119 FCC_OFF: IN+ = REF/3 (R184 20.0k / R185 10.0k, C130); IN- = FCC via R186 10.0k, R187 3.30M pu -> FCCN
U120 FCC_ON / U121 RGN_ON: IN+ = tap x R189/(R188 453k + R189 1.00M) (R190/R191 for RGN), IN- = REF: 1.75-1.88 V
U123 SN74LVC1G14 (Schmitt): BAL (T22) via R178 100k, D108 BAV199, R179 1.00M pu -> OVN = NOT(OV)
U122 SN74LVC1G08: ARM_OK' = ARM_OK . OVN -> U114 pins 2 and 6 (open tap / unpowered BQ29200 = OV = inhibit)
5 EVM interface board (EIB, 2xx) on the EVM plate (insulating, on the chassis); VCC = 3V3 from ribbon pins 1+2 via CR R176/R177 200R (R274 10k bleed); AGND = TP49 (E8) only
R272 (R42 site, link to TP27) + R272b (TP36, link to JP12) 47k /CE -> REGN on the EVM
IN- = own REF: /CE threshold ~2.5 V; R264 470R (r4)

EVM side: R21 -> 0 ohm, JP14 shunt + pin 1, JP13 pin 1 and R20 removed, R23 -> 49.9k, R256 200k + C252 2.2n across JP21 pins 1-2: regen clamp 1.33-1.76 A, FC clamp (Q202 on) 0.65-0.95 A, held <= 0.11 V
Release needs BOTH Q203 on (feed) and Q201 off (hold), each from its own driver and ribbon conductor; any open lead/resistor/driver leaves the converter in HIZ
Fail-safe: VCC = 0 -> U201/U202 outputs float -> /CE HIGH (R272/R272b), Q203 off (R271), Q201 on (R252), Q202 on (R254); pins 33/7 read LOW through pad pull-downs -> flagged
Broken sense wire: E4 -> R259 pulls U203 IN+ HIGH (reads released); E6 -> R263 pulls U204 IN+ LOW (reads /CE LOW): both are the dangerous direction and trip FR-08

Ribbon J201/J101 (1.27 mm, r4): 1 3V3 (R176), 2 3V3 (R177), 3 GND, 4 STAT (E7 TP38 via R275 1k, r5), 5 CE_DRV, 6 KEY (pin omitted), 7 ILIM_REL_A, 8 ILIM_REL_B, 9 GND, 10 RFC_OFF, 11 ILIM_SENSE, 12 GND, 13 CE_SENSE, 14 GND

Decoupling C201-C204 100 nF at each VCC/V+; C205 100 nF at Q203 source (REGN). J201 GND pins 3/9/12/14 joined -> R273 10R -> AGND (single DC ground E8). E-pad row (r6, top to bottom): E8 - E3 E4 E2 - E7 - E1 - E5 E6 (E1 and E7 isolated by empty pads; 12 positions, 27.94 mm c-c)

r7 (A.5): E-lead build maxima E8 20, E3 25, E4 30 (JP21 pin 1 = lower post), E2 35, E7 40, E1 90, E5 65, E6 60 mm; R276 10.0 ohm 1 % 0603 in series with E1 at the EIB E1 pad (E1 lead -> R276 -> REGN node, C205)
Teensy reset (pins high-Z): P5, QUAL, FCCEIL LOW (47k), HB no edges (100k) -> ARM_OK 0; EN nets LOW (10k bodge) -> FCC_ON = RGN_ON = 0 -> GATE 0; charger unpowered.
Monostable power-up: Q LOW (glitch-free reset, SCES586E) -> QQ = 0, ARM_OK = 0 until the first heartbeat edge.
Comparator POR (<= 1.9 ms, or V+ below its minimum): H1 = UVB = BT_OK = BTB_OFF = FCC_OFF = FCC_ON = RGN_ON = LOW -> H1q = H2c = 0, RFC_OFF = H1R (r6).

CR 3V3 lost: no external source back-powers it (r2); EIB outputs float -> /CE HIGH, ILIM held (if REGN up), FC clamp; pin 7 LOW with P5 LOW and REGN expected -> FR-08(b). eFuse U101 runs from VCHG-IN.
Teensy hang or stalled 1 kHz monitor: no heartbeat edges -> ARM_OK falls within 20-46 ms -> CE_DRV 0 (/CE HIGH) and ILIM_REL 0 (held) in every mode; BT_BUS stays as it was (R5).
Charger POR: ILIM clamp latched from the pin at that instant: 100 mA if held, regen or FC level if released; /CE follows P5 . ARM_OK' until firmware re-images.
r6: BQ29200 OUT HIGH (cell > 4.35 V for 1.6-4.9 s), T22 open or balance lead unplugged -> OVN 0 -> ARM_OK' 0 -> /CE HIGH and ILIM held in every mode; pin 7 shows the unexpected inhibit.
